NATIONWIDE
Elegant Desserts NY – Offers a selection of Thanksgiving cookies and desserts, including themed cookie platters and apple tarts. Click here to see their Thanksgiving collection.
Modern Bread and Bagel – Thanksgiving shipping and local pickup preorders are open. Bakery items are available for preorder November 23–26; savory items are available November 25–26. Preorders are available at all stores, with additional Thanksgiving meal items offered in NYC through Polanco Social. Select your location, pickup date, and time when ordering. Click here to see their Thanksgiving menu and place an order.

MANHATTAN
Eighteen Restaurant – Will be open for Thanksgiving with a prix fixe dinner for $95+ per person. Sushi and main menus are also available, with takeout, delivery, and Thanksgiving catering. Call 212-517-2400. Click here to see their Thanksgiving menu: Page 1 | Page 2. Located at: 240 East 81st Street (off 2nd Avenue), New York, NY
Kasbah Mediterranean Grill – Will be open for Thanksgiving with a three-course prix fixe menu: $85 per person for turkey or $100 per person for ribeye. Children 10 and under can choose a turkey plate for $35 or a three-course dinner for $55. Call 212-496-1500. Click here to see their Thanksgiving menu. Located at: 251 W. 85th St., New York, NY.
Rothschild TLV – Will be open for Thanksgiving with a turkey special and the regular menu. Located at: 1129 Lexington Ave. (between E. 78th and 79th St.), New York, NY.
Talia’s Steakhouse – Will be open for Thanksgiving on Thursday, November 26, with a four-course prix fixe dinner and indoor and outdoor seating. Five seatings are available: 12:00 p.m., 2:00 p.m., 4:30 p.m., 7:00 p.m., and 9:00 p.m. Dinner is $118+ per person. A kids’ menu is available for children 10 and under for $59. Takeout and delivery are also available for $108 per person. Reservations require a $50 deposit per table, credited toward the bill when you dine. Call 212-580-3770 to reserve. Click here to visit their Thanksgiving website. Click here to see the Thanksgiving menu. Click here to see the kids’ menu. Located at: 668 Amsterdam Ave. (between W. 92nd and 93rd St.), New York, NY.

BROOKLYN
China Glatt – Will be open for Thanksgiving, serving a traditional turkey dinner. Enjoy a free dessert with your dinner. Call 718-438-2576. Located at: 4413 13th Ave., Brooklyn, NY.

QUEENS
Marani – Will be open for Thanksgiving with dine-in and takeout options. Call 718-569-0600 or email maranigroupnyc@gmail.com to preorder by November 20. Click here to see their Thanksgiving menu. Located at 97-26 63rd Rd, Rego Park, NY.

LONG ISLAND
DOMA Land + Sea – Will be open for Thanksgiving on November 26 from 1:00–8:45 p.m., serving an à la carte menu and Thanksgiving specials. Call 516-881-7712 to reserve. Click here to see their Thanksgiving menu: Page 1 | Page 2. Located at: 490 Chestnut St, Cedarhurst, NY.
Ondas – Will be open for Thanksgiving on Thursday, November 26, 4PM – 9PM. The three-course dinner features Butternut Squash Soup, The Royal Turkey Duo, and Harvest Apple Pie with horchata ice cream. Signature cocktails will also be available. Call 516-341-0092. Click here to see their Thanksgiving menu. Located at: 488 Central Ave, Cedarhurst, NY.
Traditions: Lawrence – Offering Thanksgiving takeout packages for $240 (serves 4–6) and $385 (serves 10–12), or individual meals for $49 each, plus tax. Delivery is available to all five boroughs; delivery is not included in the prices. Call 516-295-3630 or email orders@traditionseatery.com to order. Click here to see their Thanksgiving menu. Located at: 302 Central Avenue, Lawrence, NY

MONSEY
Fireside – Will be open for Thanksgiving with a Friendsgiving dinner on November 26. Enjoy seasonal chef’s specials, drink specials all night, and a special guest from 6–9 p.m. Tables of four or more will receive a chef’s treat. Reservations are encouraged; call 845-517-3570. Click here to see their Friendsgiving menu. Located at: 59 Route 59, Monsey, NY.
The Diner – Offering a Thanksgiving plate with turkey breast and sides for $38. Pumpkin, pecan, and apple pies are available whole for $48, by the slice for $7.99, or à la mode for $11.99. Call 845-860-7173. Click here to see their Thanksgiving menu. Located at: 1669 US-202, Pomona, NY.

NEW JERSEY
ETC Steakhouse – Will be open for Thanksgiving with a traditional turkey dinner and all the fixings for $55. Call 201-357-5677 to reserve. Click here to see their Thanksgiving menu. Located at: 1409 Palisade Ave., Teaneck, NJ.
Heimish – Offering a Thanksgiving dinner package for $389, serving approximately 12 people. A la carte turkey with gravy is also available for $159.99. The Shabbos special is $169 and feeds 2 adults and 2–3 children. Every order includes a free candy tray. Call 201-644-5100 or email orders@HeimishFood.com to order. Click here to see their Thanksgiving and Shabbos menu. Located at: 182 W. Englewood Ave., Teaneck, NJ.

FLORIDA
Barrel Restaurant – Will be open for Thanksgiving with its regular menu. Located at: 419 N. Federal Highway, Hallandale Beach, FL.
Chayhana Samarkand – Offering a Thanksgiving menu with salads, hot and cold appetizers, shish kebabs, main dishes, and desserts. A 20-pound whole turkey is available for $200. Call 954-589-5540 for details. Click here to see their Thanksgiving menu. Located at: 850 W. Hallandale Beach Blvd., Hallandale Beach, FL.
Grill Place – Has a Thanksgiving package that feeds six. Orders must be placed by November 19. Pickup and delivery are available November 26 from 1–3 PM. Call (561) 334-2935 to order. Click here to see their menu. Located at 265 NE Spanish River Blvd, Boca Raton, FL 33431.
K Roasters – Has a Thanksgiving special for $29.99 per person, that gets you a generous serving of Turkey with Gravy, Mashed Sweet Potato, Stuffing, Green Beans with Silver Almonds, Cranberry Sauce, Corn Muffins, and Pumpkin or Apple Pie. Must order by 9:30 PM on Tuesday, November 24th. Click here to see their flyer. Located at: 6790 Stirling Rd, Hollywood, FL.
Maison Ostrow – Will be open Wednesday, November 25 and Thursday, November 26, with a four-course Thanksgiving menu for $105++ per person. Click here to see their Thanksgiving menu. Call (786) 803-8092 or click here to reserve. Located at 1666 79th Street Causeway, Suite 102, North Bay Village, FL.
PALA Mediterranean Kitchen – Offering Thanksgiving catering with delivery available. Call 754-219-0008 to order or request the menu. Located at: 3317 Sheridan St., Hollywood, FL.
Traditions South – Will be open for Thanksgiving with dine-in and takeout menus. The dine-in prix fixe is $55+ per adult and $30+ per child ages 15 and under. Takeout packages are available for $250 and serve 4–6 guests, or for $390 and serve 10–12 guests; individual meals are $48 each, plus tax. Call 561-295-3630 or email zeke@traditionseatery.com to order. Click here to see their dine-in Thanksgiving menu. Click here to see their takeout Thanksgiving menu. Located at: 7000 W. Camino Real, Boca Raton, FL.

CLEVELAND
Mendel’s KC BBQ – Will be open for Thanksgiving with a $70 prix fixe dinner. A limited regular menu will also be available. Takeout packages are $225 for 4 or $425 for 8; half and whole turkeys are also available for $100 and $190. Call 216-266-0035 to reserve. Click here to see their Thanksgiving dinner menu. Click here to see their Thanksgiving takeout menu. Located at: 20314 Chagrin Blvd, Cleveland, OH.

CALIFORNIA
Beverly Hills Kosher –Offering Thanksgiving catering, including a $299 package that serves 10–12 people, plus à la carte salads, soups, sides, entrees, and pies. Free home delivery is available. Orders must be placed by November 16. Call 310-276-7232 or email info@beverlyhillskosher.com. Click here to see their Thanksgiving menu. Located at: 9213 W. Pico Blvd., Los Angeles, CA.
La Gondola Ristorante – Will be open for Thanksgiving with both dine-in and takeout menus. Dinner is $94 per adult and $72 per child under 10; prime rib is available for an additional $35. The takeout package feeds 10–12 guests for $725 plus tax. Orders must be placed by Tuesday, November 17. Email orders to info@lagondola.com for pickup at La Gondola Restaurant. Click here to see the dine-in menu, here for additional menu items and pricing, here for the takeout dessert menu, and here for the full takeout package. Located at: 9025 Wilshire Blvd., Beverly Hills, CA.
Lieder’s – Offering a Thanksgiving dinner package for $599+ (serves 10–12) and à la carte options, including whole turkey, sliced turkey breast, sides, salads, and pies. Order by Monday, November 23 at 11 a.m. Pickup and delivery are available Thursday, November 26, from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. Call 310-909-7223 or email pico@orderlieders.com. Click here to see the à la carte menu. Click here to see the dinner package menu. Click here to visit their website. Located at: 8721 W. Pico Blvd., Los Angeles, CA.
Tierra Sur – Will be open for Thanksgiving with a three-course prix fixe dinner and family-style sides. The menu is $95+ per adult and $45+ per child. Call 805-983-1560 for reservations and menu details. Click here to see their Thanksgiving menu. Located at: 3201 Camino Del Sol, Oxnard, CA.

LAS VEGAS
Burnt Offerings – Will be open for Thanksgiving with a turkey breast dinner. Reservations are encouraged, and takeout should be ordered in advance. Call 702-848-2876. Located at: 3909 W. Sahara Ave., Suite 10, Las Vegas, NV.
